application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
decision_conditions:
A Section 211 Notification was recently received (ref: TP26/0310) outlining a proposal to remove the Corkscrew Willow from the rear gardens of Kings Lee, Eel Pie Island, Twickenham. The justification provided was that tree was to be removed due to poor location.

The tree at the rear of the property is a significant and prominent landscape feature of the local , providing green relief within the locality and significant ecosystem benefits.  The loss of these tree would have a notable detrimental impact upon the local and wider landscape.  The justification that has been provided is insufficient to demonstrate that the tree requires removal, and it is considered expedient in the interest of amenity to safeguard the tree with this tree preservation order.
